records.name: Spirit Stab
records.skill_description: Perform a quick thrusting attack with a Ki sword.
records.mechanics_notes: Spirit Stab is a fast long-range Ki-blade thrust that causes a soft stun/paralysis and bypasses guard. The attack is distinct from Spirit Sword: Spirit Stab is a Super while Spirit Sword is an Ultimate. Detailed frame and damage values are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
records.acquisition_notes: Spirit Stab was introduced with Super Pack 4 and, after the 1.07.00 update, became obtainable by the Future Warrior through the TP Medal Shop.
records.pve_notes: TP Medal Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Independent community documentation describes the move as a quick, long-range, guard-bypassing Strike Super useful for punishing attacks and creating a stun opening. Exact matchup/frame claims remain version-sensitive.
